title: Is it possible to use real-time text instead of sound output?
body: This is a great project, but there are many limitations on the language of the voice. It would be perfect if the code could be modified to output text instead of voice. It seems that there is no such function at present. If I want to modify this part myself, can you give me some guidance?
author: wublubdubdaxml

comments.body: I really need this ,plz someone help me
Hey, @wublubdubdaxml! Made a branch for you :)

I don't know. Currently, the model, seems to me, speaks poorly in languages other than English. I guess Google will ship a bigger and better model in a few weeks that will be able to speak in more languages. It does understand a lot of languages though, just the pronunciation is not great,

title: Calling the phone's rear camera
body:
Hello, thank you for your efforts.
The front camera is automatically selected at the startup of the mobile browser, can I change it so that I can select the front and back camera when I use the mobile browser?
author: babyedi3

comments.body: Hey, @babyedi3, check it out now and see if it works.
